gloss: to look out over; to survey; to scan

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {見渡|みわた}しませんでした

forms.negative: {見渡|みわた}していなかった

definitions.gloss: to look out over; to survey; to take in a view
definitions.explanation: To look across a wide area, typically from an elevated position.
To look around an area comprehensively, often to find or check something.

examples.english: I looked out over the town from the top of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {見渡|みわた}す⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: As far as the eye could see, the ocean stretched out.
examples.notes: {見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}り = as far as one can see

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見渡|みわた}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked out over the city from the observation deck, I could see Mt. Fuji in the distance.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Pattern: [place]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見渡|みわた}す

ASPECT (ている):
{見渡|みわた}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing surveying or a resulting state of having surveyed.

- {見渡|みわた}さない (negative)
- {見渡|みわた}して (te-form)
- {見渡|みわた}した (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見渡|みわた}す⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ - as far as the eye can see
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見渡|みわた}す - to look around
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見渡|みわた}す - to scan the venue
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見渡|みわた}す - to overlook the town

COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (see) + ⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ (to cross over) → to look across
